## Research and publications

- [Cumulant Tensors in Partitioned Independent Component Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.10089): Algebraic-statistics preprint with Bernd Sturmfels.
- [p-anisotropy on the moment curve for homology manifolds and cycles](https://doi.org/10.1007/s00493-025-00192-w): Combinatorica publication with Karim Adiprasito.
- [Differential Power Operation on Ideals](https://msp.org/involve/2026/19-2/involve-v19-n2-p02-s.pdf): Involve publication with Jennifer Kenkel, Janet Page, and Daniel Smolkin.
- [Analyzing Network Topology for DDoS Mitigation Using the Abelian Sandpile Model](http://people.reed.edu/%7Emostephen/hw%20/ASM_SIAM.pdf): Network-topology research with Christof Teuscher and Art Duval.
- [LDMX, Light Dark Matter eXperiment](http://people.reed.edu/%7Emostephen/hw%20/A_Brief_Summary_of_Research_Preformed_at_APD_in_the_Summer_of_2019.pdf): Particle-detector research with Andrew Whitbeck.

## Software projects

- [opn](https://github.com/monroestephenson/opn): Network-telemetry CLI with structured output for agents.
- [FlowSketch](https://github.com/monroestephenson/flowsketch): Streaming network-flow sketches under bounded memory.
- [Literature map source](https://github.com/monroestephenson/monroestephenson.github.io/tree/main/tools/literature): Source for The Long Inheritance.
